ranking.bootstrap_duplicate_tie_break: risk, frozen claim tie hash, sampled occurrence position

metrics.coverage: accepted claim count / eligible claim count
metrics.aurc: arithmetic mean of prefix selective risks for k=1..n; no oracle normalization

bootstrap.group_construction_population: all 141 Internal Test claims before eligibility filtering
bootstrap.group_id: minimum claim ID in connected component
bootstrap.sampling_population: connected groups containing at least one eligible claim
bootstrap.draws_per_replicate: number of eligible-containing groups, sampled with replacement
bootstrap.include_draw: all eligible claims in each sampled group; retain repeated group occurrences
bootstrap.coverage_recalculation: recompute n and floor(0.8*n + 0.5) in every replicate
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5th and 97.5th quantiles using numpy linear interpolation
bootstrap.invalid_auroc_replicate: record and omit only AUROC when sampled y_error has one class; keep AURC and R80
bootstrap.empty_sampling_population: stop; primary evaluation is not estimable

primary_contrast.name: EARS_minus_B1
primary_contrast.supported: both point differences are negative and both paired 95% CI upper bounds are strictly below zero
primary_contrast.unfavorable: both point differences are positive and both paired 95% CI lower bounds are strictly above zero
primary_contrast.inconclusive: every other outcome, including either interval containing zero
primary_contrast.final_evidence_rule: Phase 3B independent result is reported regardless of whether it agrees with Phase 2B; no favorable-result selection

small_sample_rules.n_positive: AURC and R80 remain mechanically defined
small_sample_rules.fewer_than_two_eligible_groups: report descriptive metrics but H1 inferential conclusion is NOT_EVALUABLE
small_sample_rules.single_y_error_class_overall: AUROC is NA; AURC/R80 and paired contrasts remain reported; H1 cannot be SUPPORTED if paired intervals are degenerate at zero
small_sample_rules.low_power: report wide intervals without changing alpha, replicates, endpoints or success rule

secondary_analysis_control.confirmatory_claims: none beyond the primary EARS-vs-B1 contrast
secondary_analysis_control.multiplicity_adjustment: not applied because secondary results are explicitly descriptive
